claims.text: A Procedural Graph keeps an explicit editable directed graph of procedures outside the model and retrieves only the active node neighbourhood for situational guidance.
Rejected graph edits are retained as negative constraints while only candidates that preserve or improve held-out validation are adopted.

limitations: The source concerns agent context or knowledge representations rather than filesystem lifecycle artifacts, so only the separation, addressing, and recovery mechanisms transfer.
The paper is a preprint and does not independently validate a MOZAK implementation.

claims.text: Trace as State places a compact task-state proxy before the long context on a fresh pass, so the state guides rereading rather than being appended after history.

The matched placement control used identical trace content after the context and lost in 26 of 27 reported combinations, showing that working-set ordering matters independently of retained source content.
